text:
sophia: quick question after the CP separation RFC — do we want per-customer private endpoints to resolve to regional anchors or per-tenant relays?
tim: leaning regional anchors for fewer NATs and simpler routing, but customers with IP whitelisting might want stable per-tenant egress ips.
sophia: right. we could offer two modes: anchor-backed endpoints (ephemeral anchor behind stable vip) vs relay-backed endpoints (sticky NAT per tenant).
nana: (cc ops) cost note: relay-backed increases SNAT table pressure. anchor-backed needs more certificate churn handling.
tim: for certs, short-lived leaf certs from a global signer works; private installs can optionally upload signed bundles.
sophia: discovery: prefer SRV for hosted, local file or env override for Private. SDK defaults: local first (30ms), regional (200ms), global (800ms).
nana: ops-bot: scheduled perf spike comparing vip+anchor vs per-tenant-nat on Tue 22:00 UTC
ops-bot: note: please add warmup prefetch for anchors to avoid KV cold-starts (top-50 prefixes).
tim: streaming note — require sticky session tokens that include anchor_id and expiry. servers should accept resume tokens to continue KV sync.
sophia: next steps: tim + ana to draft config modes and token spec; ops to run perf spike. leaving thread for RFC follow-up.
